terra.problem: “Nobody gets handed off to anybody” makes a broader claim than the verse states.
The verse says the LORD rises to show compassion; it does not say He comes toward the people.
The verse mentions turning right or left and commands them to walk, but does not say the people are out walking.
“First He binds up, then He heals” adds a sequence the verse does not give.
The verse says the nations are sifted, but does not explicitly say His own people are excluded.
The verse compares their rejoicing to that of one walking to the mountain; it does not say they go up.
The verse says their hearts will rejoice like one walking to the mountain, not that they are walking there.
The people going up to the mountain are part of a comparison; the verse does not say the people addressed are making that journey.
“Then He strikes them” adds an order between Assyria being shattered and the LORD striking them that the verse does not state.
